headline: Executive session on union negotiations, then school improvement plans, CTE department, and FY '26 and FY '27 budget transfers.
summary: The committee meets in executive session on collective bargaining and litigation matters, then holds a regular meeting covering school improvement plans for Kennedy, McDevitt, and Valor High School, Waltham High School's CTE Department and schedule, and FY '26 and FY '27 budget transfers.

WALTHAM SCHOOL COMMITTEE 
 Waltham, Massachusetts 
 JAMES J. CANNON LECTURE HALL  617 LEXINGTON STREET 
 DOCKET  OCTOBER 7, 2026 
 *ADDENDUM* 
 5:30 p.m.  EXECUTIVE SESSION 
 1.  To conduct strategy sessions with respect to collective bargaining with the WSSA and/or to conduct 
 negotiations with the WSSA 
 2.  To conduct strategy sessions with respect to collective bargaining with the WSAA and/or to conduct 
 negotiations with the WSAA 
 3.  To conduct strategy sessions with respect to collective bargaining with the Waltham School MIS Technicians 
 and/or to conduct negotiations with the Waltham School MIS Technicians 
 4.  To conduct strategy sessions with respect to collective bargaining with the Waltham School Department 
 Food Service Workers and/or to conduct negotiations with the Waltham School Department Food Service 
 Workers 
 5.  To conduct strategy sessions in preparation for negotiations with nonunion personnel and/or to conduct 
 negotiations with nonunion personnel  – Assistant Superintendent for Finance and Operations 
 6.  To conduct strategy sessions with respect to collective bargaining with the Waltham Building Maintenance 
 Workers Association and/or to conduct negotiations with the Waltham Building Maintenance Workers 
 Association 
 7.  In accordance with Mass. G.L. c. 30A, Section 21(a)(3), to discuss strategy with respect to litigation if an 
 open meeting may have a detrimental effect on the litigating position of the public body and the chair so
